story.title: The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models

draft:
I've been experimenting with Claude 5 generation models and stumbled upon an insightful blog post on context engineering. 
The new rules outlined in the post highlight the importance of fine-tuning context to improve model performance. 
Key takeaways include the need for more nuanced understanding of context and its impact on output quality.
What are some potential applications of these new rules in real-world projects?
